description: This Java class defines a command 'ModifyAcl' that modifies the complete Access Control List (ACL) of a 'Thing' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON, accessing the ACL, and serializing the command payload.

classes.name: ModifyAcl
classes.description: A command class that modifies the complete Access Control List (ACL) of a Thing in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It supports creation from JSON, payload serialization, and equality checks.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ModifyAcl command with a ThingId, ACL, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ModifyAcl command instance from a JSON string or object.

methods.name: getAccessControlList
methods.description: Returns the ACL to be applied.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing entity.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Serializes the ACL to JSON according to schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path for the ACL resource.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the command payload to a JSON object builder.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: changesAuthorization
methods.description: Indicates that this command changes authorization (returns true).
